name: Energy meter with maximum-demand indicator
summary: Energy meter that also records the highest average power over a fixed demand interval for demand charging.
description: This meter totalises energy and also keeps the maximum average power reached in any demand interval, such as 15 or 30 minutes. Large supplies are often billed partly on that maximum demand, so the meter form appears on the supply single-line diagram with the demand interval stated nearby.

The demand register is reset periodically, usually at the end of a billing period. The symbol does not show the interval, whether it uses fixed blocks or a sliding window, or how reset is performed, and those settings change the recorded value.
readingNotes: Find the demand interval and window type.
Check how and when the demand register is reset.
distinction: A maximum-demand meter records peak averaged power plus energy; a maximum-demand indicator shows only the peak value.
